summary: Stop automatic Claude restarts when organization policy blocks channels and report the required managed setting.

replay.detail: No graph replay change. Policy refusals use existing runtime action failure and reconciliation decision records.

schema.detail: No database schema or migration change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules, digests or member coordination change.

compatibility.detail: New supervisors recognize the Claude organization-policy banner and retain a refusal for the launching declaration. Older supervisors do not honor this policy-specific restart fence after downgrade and may attempt ordinary channel recovery.

downtime.detail: No additional fleet-wide interruption is required. An affected policy-blocked Claude runtime is stopped because its channel cannot receive messages.

manual.detail: For affected Enterprise or Team organizations, an administrator must set channelsEnabled: true in Claude Code managed settings, then explicitly restart the agent.

recovery.detail: A recognized organization-policy refusal stops automatic retries and surfaces an actionable agent fault. An explicit restart or replacement declaration permits a new attempt; unrelated transient channel recovery retains its existing bounded retry budget.
